svg.title: fraction / gap_thinking_fraction_comparison
svg.desc: States are arranged radially. Dark and muted lines record conserving and neutral stances. For deforming transitions, blue records a correct doing the context makes insufficient; rust records a claim that is false on its own. Mixed transitions have a blue base and rust overlay. Unreviewed rows remain rust.
